name: Signal Cluster S11: Calendar Detection (Period Boundaries)
description: Tests: is_period_boundary(period, boundary, ordinal, day_anchor, day_of_month, offset). Monthly/quarterly/OPEX detection, T-1 offset.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S11: is_period_boundary
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
rets = returns(close)

# === PERIOD BOUNDARIES ===
month_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())
month_end = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end)(index())
quarter_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.quarter, boundary=BoundaryType.start)(index())

# === OPEX (3rd Friday) ===
opex = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, ordinal=OrdinalType.third, day_anchor=DayAnchorType.friday)(index())

# === T-1 PRE-POSITIONING ===
t_minus_1 = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.end, offset=-1)(index())

# === REPORTERS ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='Month Start'
    )
)(rets, month_start)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Close', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ],
        title='OPEX (3rd Friday)'
    )
)(close, opex)
